title: Floodgate UUID Finder
description: Finds the fuuid of bedrock players, so you can whitelist them on your server.
body:
![Floodgate UUID Finder](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96bc34b56e95b045b3a6863ad26549a2fb5ae60c_0.webp)
# Fuuid Finder

Fuuid Finder is a lightweight Paper plugin that lets you look up a Bedrock player’s Floodgate UUID from a username. It is designed to be simple, fast, and easy to use.

**How does it work?**

This plugin sends an API request to [MCCompanion](https://mccompanion.net/). Then sends you a formatted version of the FUUID.

**The command is:**

/fuuid <player_name>

**Permissions:**
- fuuidfinder.fuuid - Allows players to run /fuuid
